programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Nazar Andaaz
programs.desc: Sudhir, who is visually impaired, shares his home only with his maid Bhavani until he temporarily brings in Ali to assist during her absence, unknowingly setting off a tense rivalry as jealousy builds between Bhavani and Ali. Vikrant Deshmukh.

programs.title: I Am Crazy About Love
programs.desc: Sanjana's parents want her to marry Prem. After a few misunderstandings, both fall in love. Then chaos descends when they find out that this Prem is a deceiver Hrithik Roshan, Kareena Kapoor, Abhishek Bachchan, Sooraj R. Barjatya, Sooraj R. Barjatya.

programs.title: My Captive
programs.desc: A beautiful yet complicated love blossoms between a spontaneous young man and a girl of strong values and pure intentions. As emotions intensify, their relationship becomes entangled in betrayal, desire, and heartbreak. Hania Aamir, Bilal Abbas Khan.

programs.title: Mannat
programs.desc: Drama Mannat, a gifted chef, works under a boss who is unknowingly her biological mother, and as her dreams for the future collide with the hidden truths of her past, fate begins to reorder her life. Mukta Dhond.

programs.title: Jhanak
programs.desc: Determined to fulfill her mother's dream of a better life, a young woman faces numerous trials and personal loss, only to have her journey further complicated by a man she meets along the way. Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja.
